decisions: 3 Monts: six current 3 Monts recipes and four Du Moulin recipes from the same domestic brewery, each counted once across formats. Primary range pages supply alcohol values: Triple 9.5%, IPA 5.6%, Du Moulin Session IPA 4.3%, Du Moulin Bock 3.9%. Numbers in the producer name do not encode strength. Saison is included as a current named range product, not an ephemeral/seasonal release; its formal style is left null because the page only labels it a blonde tasting beer.

Mont Blanc: six selected beers verified on individual producer pages. Actual current specifications: La Neipa 4.7%, Triple Epices 7.2%, La Cristal 4.7%, La Blanche 4.7%, La Blonde 5.8%, La Rousse 6.5%. Current La Cristal is labelled Pale Ale by the producer; do not relabel it a lager from colour/name. Belgian Blonde Ale and Witbier describe style, not Belgian origin. Regional packaging exclusivity does not create another product or promise local availability.

Mont Blanc's old Python TLS client could not connect. A modern Node HTTPS client retrieved the public pages with normal certificate verification; specifications were read from actual HTML without disabling security. La Cristal IPA was not included because its returned specification extract did not establish an alcohol value during review; no value was guessed.

Goudale: four current La Goudale beers checked on individual producer pages: Blonde, Ambree and IPA are 7.2%; Hop Lager is 5.2%. Producer colour/type labels are retained conservatively rather than imposing an unsupported formal style. These are different recipes, not bottle/can/pack-size duplicates.

Origin: 3 Monts identifies its French Flanders brewery in Saint-Sylvestre-Cappel; Mont Blanc's contact/product pages give La Motte-Servolex, FRANCE; Goudale identifies its French brewery and Arques address. Product source URLs establish facts, not reuse rights for logos or photos.

Excluded imported portfolio brands, alcohol-free ranges, soft drinks, Radler/shandy or spirit/fruit mixed-drink lines, barrel-aged/reserve and ephemeral/seasonal editions. Excluding uncertain selections does not claim they are not beers; it keeps this first batch within verified scope. No copied marketing descriptions or dietary suitability claims.

All twenty products retain the Matchbound seal until exact approved artwork exists. No logos/photos are downloaded in this batch. Country selection does not promise pub/stadium stock, and city-average prices remain independent. Saved draws and existing legacy brands remain intact.
